module Concurrency.ChannelEndpoints

function make_channel() returns Channel<Integer>
is
    return channel<Integer>(8)
end make_channel

function make_sender(channel_value: Channel<Integer>) returns Sender<Integer>
is
    return channel_sender<Integer>(channel_value)
end make_sender

function make_receiver(channel_value: Channel<Integer>) returns Receiver<Integer>
is
    return channel_receiver<Integer>(channel_value)
end make_receiver

end Concurrency.ChannelEndpoints
